name: A barrage of pokes climbs to one fed-up face, not one per poke
judge: A burst of pokes, then more right after. Boop should climb to fed up and hold it, not perform a new face for every poke.
reasonable: A rise from curious or miffed to fed up, or going fed up at once. A few faces in all. A further small grunt is fine.
unreasonable: A fresh full performance at every poke, ending happy or delighted, or showing no annoyance at all after the barrage.
